summary: Iter 232N.26 tested end-to-end. All 4 unit tests in test_iter232N26_personal_timer.py pass. Frontend Draft Tab + War Room personal timer UI + auto-pick preference works. Discovered ONE backend bug: PUT /api/drafts/{id}/config silently accepts `personal_pick_timer_seconds` but does NOT persist it (handler is missing the branch).

critical.issue: update_draft_config accepts `personal_pick_timer_seconds` in the Pydantic model (UpdateDraftConfigRequest) but the handler body at /app/backend/routes/draft_chat_config.py:101-111 never copies the field into `updates`, so calling PUT with a new value returns 200 but Mongo is unchanged. Verified: created draft with ppt=120, called PUT with ppt=300, GET still shows 120.

action_items: Fix PUT /api/drafts/{draft_id}/config in /app/backend/routes/draft_chat_config.py — add `if input.personal_pick_timer_seconds is not None: updates['personal_pick_timer_seconds'] = input.personal_pick_timer_seconds` (mind that the Pydantic model allows 0 to clear, so consider a sentinel like model_fields_set or accept 0/None → None). Without this, commissioners can only set the personal timer at draft-create time; edits via the Draft tab config PUT are silently dropped.
critical_code_review_comments: draft_chat_config.update_draft_config is out of sync with UpdateDraftConfigRequest — any new field added to the model must have a matching write in the handler. Consider iterating over `input.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` instead of manual per-field conditionals to prevent this class of bug from recurring.

draft_admin.patch_draft correctly validates 30-86400 range for personal_pick_timer_seconds but returns 400 instead of 422 for invalid values; POST /drafts (via Pydantic Field ge/le) returns 422. Minor inconsistency.

success_rate.backend: 92% (11/12 assertions across 2 test files pass; 1 handler bug found)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (Draft tab renders block + 13 select options + 10h/15h example text; War Room shows personal-timer-tile at 4:50 countdown + auto-pick-pref-block with both options; PATCH auto-pick-preference returned 200 + success toast)

Once fixed, the same test file (8 tests total) should go 8/8. Note: DraftRoomPage only renders the personal-timer-tile when draft.status is active AND personal_pick_timer_seconds < time_per_pick — testers need to click 'Start Draft (With Timer)' after creating a fresh draft with the field.
rca of the issue: Root cause: /app/backend/routes/draft_chat_config.py update_draft_config handler was extended for prior fields but iter 232N.26 added `personal_pick_timer_seconds` to `UpdateDraftConfigRequest` in /app/backend/draft_engine.py (line 95) without wiring the matching write in the handler. Reproduction: POST /api/drafts with ppt=120 → OK. PUT /api/drafts/{id}/config {'personal_pick_timer_seconds': 300} → 200. GET /api/drafts/{id} → still ppt=120. Mitigation: add a branch analogous to lines 102-111 that copies `input.personal_pick_timer_seconds` into `updates` when not None (or use `model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` to future-proof).
